rows.policy: Track host-validated actor identities, sweep a bounding sphere through both apertures, require host exit clearance, preserve momentum, and commit cooldown only after a successful host move. Invalid session or replacement portal clears previous samples.

id.evidence: Runtime coordinator configuration for the accepted linked momentum-portal design; this sheet verifies configuration only, not GTA integration.

cooldownSeconds.evidence: Matches portals.linked_pair; suppress immediate reverse crossing for 0.3 seconds after successful movement.

exitPaddingMeters.evidence: Chosen clearance margin beyond the actor bounding sphere; the host must independently test destination collision.

maxSampleGapSeconds.evidence: Discard segments older than 0.25 seconds so pause, loading, or stale samples cannot trigger delayed traversal.

policy.evidence: Explicit gameplay invariant; host integration and in-game proof remain separate gates.
